mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) indicate accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% periods with statistical significance (p > 0.05) in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 850 thousand units signal weakening residential construction demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as economic activity contraction accelerates.
failure_condition: HOUST < 850 periods yield positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as wage pressures boost consumer spending.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fail to produce positive returns in >60% of instances with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 230.5 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting monetary policy tightening that suppresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 230.5 periods with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) below 400 billion dollars indicate weakening consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as economic momentum decelerates.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 400 periods yield positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 indicates contraction in manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions accelerate.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 97.0 periods produce positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP revision (GDPC1) exceeding vintage value by >20% signals upward economic growth reassessment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market confidence strengthens.
failure_condition: GDPC1 revision >20% periods yield negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.0% indicates labor market strength, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as job security boosts consumer confidence.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 8.0 periods produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances.
